subject: CHANGELOG.md includes a 1.4.0 section dated 2026-09-29 and keeps an empty Unrele
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
text = Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text()
_, _, rest = text.partition("## [Unreleased]")
body, sep, _tail = rest.partition("## [1.4.0] - 2026-09-29")
assert sep and not body.strip()
assert "No git tag" not in text
assert "stays 1.3.0" not in text
assert text.count("backfilled on 2026-09-29 and points at") == 2
assert "a540efb" in text and "f4d96d3" in text
print("changelog 1.4.0 header and backfilled tags ok")'
